steps.input:
src='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    if any(all(v == 2 for v in row) for row in g):
        axis = 0
        divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(g) if all(v == 2 for v in row))
    else:
        axis = 1
        divider = next(c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h)))
    counts = {}
    for row in g:
        for value in row:
            if value not in (2, 8):
                counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    cells = [(r, c, g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if g[r][c] not in (background, 2, 8)]
    if not cells:
        return g
    coords = [p[axis] for p in cells]
    lo, hi = min(coords), max(coords)
    if hi < divider:
        shift = divider - 1 - hi
        marker = lo + shift - 1
    else:
        shift = divider + 1 - lo
        marker = hi + shift + 1
    for r, c, _ in cells:
        g[r][c] = background
    for r, c, value in cells:
        q = [r, c]
        q[axis] += shift
        g[q[0]][q[1]] = value
    if 0 <= marker < (h if axis == 0 else w):
        if axis == 0:
            g[marker] = [8] * w
        else:
            for r in range(h):
                g[r][marker] = 8
    return g
'''
